reviews.summary: Suggested removing comments that don't add value to the file. Noted that two loops would likely be optimized out on architectures of interest.

2026-11-23.patch_summary: This patch breaks out a helper function, gup_fill_pages(), to store pages in an array. The helper is shared by the slow and fast paths of __get_user_pages(). This change simplifies the code and reduces duplication.
